blocks.zh: 1.0 Introduction 1.0 導論
blocks.en: 1.0 Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Contamination Control Strategy, CCS (污染控制策略)：CCS 是一套經過規劃的流程與措施，用於識別、評估、控制和監測污染風險。它不是一份單獨的 SOP，而是一份「傘式文件 (umbrella document)」，將分散在各處的污染控制措施整合在一起，形成一個可以被整體評估的策略。
blocks.en: Contamination Control Strategy, CCS: A CCS is a planned set of processes and measures used to identify, assess, control and monitor contamination risks. It is not a single SOP but an "umbrella document" that brings contamination control measures scattered across the site together into one strategy that can be evaluated as a whole.

blocks.zh: Holistic Approach (整體性方法)：過去製藥業的污染控制措施是「各做各的」，例如清潔驗證歸清潔驗證、環境監測歸環境監測。TR90 強調的轉變是：這些措施必須被設計為一個互相配合的整體，並且要針對每個特定製程的風險量身定制。
blocks.en: Holistic Approach: In the past, contamination control measures in the pharmaceutical industry were handled in silos; for example, cleaning validation belonged to cleaning validation and environmental monitoring belonged to environmental monitoring. The shift TR90 emphasizes is that these measures must be designed as an integrated whole that works together, and must be tailored to the risks of each specific process.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像一家醫院的感染管控計畫 (Hospital Infection Control Plan)。醫院裡有手術室消毒、醫護人員洗手規定、空調過濾系統、訪客管理、廢棄物處理等眾多措施。如果這些措施各自為政——手術室消毒做得很好，但廢棄物處理鬆散——整體感染風險仍然很高。CCS 就像是醫院的「感染管控總策略」，它把所有措施串連起來，確保每一環都到位、互相支援，而且會根據不同病房（如 ICU vs. 普通病房）的風險等級來調整強度。
blocks.en: Imagine a hospital infection control plan. A hospital has many measures: operating room disinfection, hand hygiene rules for staff, air filtration systems, visitor management, waste handling and more. If these measures work in silos (excellent operating room disinfection but lax waste handling), the overall infection risk is still high. A CCS is like the hospital's "overall infection control strategy": it links all the measures together, makes sure every link is in place and supports the others, and adjusts the intensity to the risk level of each ward (for example, ICU vs. general ward).

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: TR90 的定位：本報告不是要取代或重複現有的各項技術指引（如清潔驗證、無菌製程等），而是作為一張「路線圖 (roadmap)」，幫助你把所有相關的 GMP 實踐串連成一個有邏輯、可評估的整體策略。
blocks.en: Positioning of TR90: This report is not meant to replace or repeat existing technical guidance (such as cleaning validation or aseptic processing). It serves as a "roadmap" that helps you link all the relevant GMP practices into one logical, assessable, holistic strategy.

blocks.zh: 法規驅動：EU GMP Annex 1 (2022修訂版) 明確要求製造商建立正式的 CCS 文件。這不再是「建議」而是「要求」，使得 TR90 成為業界建立 CCS 的重要參考指引。
blocks.en: Regulatory driver: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022 revision) explicitly requires manufacturers to establish a formal CCS document. This is no longer a "recommendation" but a "requirement", which makes TR90 an important industry reference for building a CCS.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你所在的工廠目前有哪些污染控制措施？這些措施之間是否有明確的關聯性，還是各自獨立運作？
blocks.en: What contamination control measures does your site currently have? Are these measures clearly linked to one another, or do they operate independently?

blocks.zh: 如果你要向工廠高層簡報「為什麼我們需要建立 CCS 文件」，你會用哪三個論點來說服他們？
blocks.en: If you had to brief site leadership on "why we need a CCS document", which three arguments would you use to persuade them?

blocks.zh: TR90 提到 CCS 要針對「每個特定製程的風險」量身定制。請想一想：生產注射劑 (sterile injectable) 和生產口服固體劑型 (oral solid dosage) 的 CCS 會有什麼本質上的差異？
blocks.en: TR90 says a CCS should be tailored to the "risks of each specific process". Consider: what are the fundamental differences between the CCS for a sterile injectable and the CCS for an oral solid dosage product?

blocks.zh: 1.1 Purpose 1.1 目的
blocks.en: 1.1 Purpose

blocks.zh: 新廠 vs. 現有廠 (New vs. Existing)：TR90 的適用對象涵蓋兩種情境：
blocks.en: New vs. Existing: TR90 applies to two situations:

blocks.zh: 新建廠房/新製程：可以從設計階段 (design phase) 就將 CCS 的思維融入，從一開始就建立整體性的污染控制策略。這是最理想的情況。
blocks.en: New facilities/new processes: The CCS mindset can be built in from the design phase, establishing a holistic contamination control strategy from the very beginning. This is the ideal case.

blocks.zh: 現有廠房/現有製程：需要將已經存在的各項污染控制措施「收集、整理、串連」成一份 CCS 文件，並識別出潛在的缺口 (gaps)。對多數公司而言，這才是更常見的現實挑戰。
blocks.en: Existing facilities/existing processes: The contamination control measures already in place need to be "collected, organized and linked" into a CCS document, and potential gaps identified. For most companies, this is the more common real-world challenge.

blocks.zh: 這就像整理你家的保險計畫。如果你剛買了新房子，可以一開始就規劃完整的保險組合（火險、地震險、竊盜險等）。但如果你已經住了十年，各種保險可能是在不同時間、不同保險公司分別購買的，現在需要有人幫你把所有保單整理成一份總覽表，看看有沒有重複或遺漏。TR90 就是那份「整理指南」。
blocks.en: This is like organizing your household insurance. If you have just bought a new house, you can plan a complete insurance package from the start (fire, earthquake, theft and so on). But if you have lived there for ten years, the various policies may have been bought at different times from different insurers, and now someone needs to compile all the policies into one overview to check for overlaps or omissions. TR90 is that "organizing guide".

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO (委託開發暨製造組織) 而言，建立 CCS 的挑戰更大：你的廠房可能同時生產多種不同客戶的產品，每個產品的風險特性不同。CCS 需要有足夠的彈性來涵蓋這些差異，同時又要有統一的框架。
blocks.en: For a CDMO (contract development and manufacturing organization), building a CCS is even more challenging: your facility may manufacture products for several different clients at the same time, each with different risk characteristics. The CCS needs enough flexibility to cover these differences while still providing a unified framework.

blocks.zh: 1.2 Scope 1.2 範圍
blocks.en: 1.2 Scope

blocks.zh: TR90 涵蓋的三大污染類型：
blocks.en: The three types of contamination covered by TR90:

blocks.zh: Microbial contamination (微生物污染)：細菌、黴菌、酵母菌，以及其他外來微生物 (adventitious agents) 如病毒、支原體等
blocks.en: Microbial contamination: Bacteria, molds, yeasts, and other adventitious agents such as viruses and mycoplasma

blocks.zh: Pyrogens/Endotoxin (熱原/內毒素)：革蘭氏陰性菌細胞壁成分，即使微生物被殺滅，內毒素仍可能殘留並引起發熱反應
blocks.en: Pyrogens/Endotoxin: Components of the cell wall of Gram-negative bacteria; even after the microorganisms are killed, endotoxin can remain and cause a fever response

blocks.zh: Foreign particulate matter (外來微粒)：不應存在於產品中的外來顆粒，如纖維、金屬碎片、玻璃碎屑等
blocks.en: Foreign particulate matter: Extraneous particles that should not be present in the product, such as fibers, metal fragments and glass shards

blocks.zh: TR90 涵蓋的三大產品類型：
blocks.en: The three types of product covered by TR90:

blocks.zh: Sterile drugs (無菌藥品)：注射劑、眼用製劑等，需要最嚴格的污染控制
blocks.en: Sterile drugs: Injectables, ophthalmic preparations and so on, which require the most stringent contamination control

blocks.zh: Low bioburden drug substances (低生物負荷原料藥)：製程中需維持低微生物水準的原料藥
blocks.en: Low bioburden drug substances: Drug substances for which a low microbial level must be maintained during processing

blocks.zh: Nonsterile drugs vulnerable to contamination (易受污染的非無菌藥品)：如口服液劑、某些外用製劑等
blocks.en: Nonsterile drugs vulnerable to contamination: Such as oral liquids and certain topical preparations

blocks.zh: 排除範圍同樣重要！TR90 明確排除了以下內容：
blocks.en: What is excluded is just as important! TR90 explicitly excludes the following:

blocks.zh: Chemical contaminants (化學污染物)：包括交叉污染 (cross-contamination)，這由其他指引處理（如 EU GMP Chapter 3, 5）
blocks.en: Chemical contaminants: Including cross-contamination, which is addressed by other guidance (such as EU GMP Chapters 3 and 5)

blocks.zh: Inherent particulate matter (固有微粒)：產品本身特性造成的微粒（如蛋白質聚集體），不屬於外來污染
blocks.en: Inherent particulate matter: Particles arising from the nature of the product itself (such as protein aggregates), which are not extraneous contamination

blocks.zh: Secondary/tertiary packaging (二次/三次包裝)：外箱、標籤等非直接接觸產品的包裝
blocks.en: Secondary/tertiary packaging: Outer cartons, labels and other packaging that does not directly contact the product

blocks.zh: 了解排除範圍可以幫助你聚焦：CCS 要解決的是「不該出現在產品中的微生物、熱原和外來微粒」。
blocks.en: Understanding the exclusions helps you stay focused: a CCS addresses "microorganisms, pyrogens and foreign particulate matter that should not be in the product".

blocks.zh: 就像餐廳的食品安全計畫：TR90 關注的是「食材裡不該有的東西」（如細菌、異物），而不是「食材本身的營養成分比例」（那是配方問題）。同樣地，餐廳外帶紙袋的印刷品質（二次包裝）也不在這份食安計畫的範圍內。
blocks.en: It is like a restaurant's food safety plan: TR90 is concerned with "things that should not be in the ingredients" (such as bacteria and foreign objects), not with "the nutritional proportions of the ingredients themselves" (that is a recipe question). Likewise, the print quality of the restaurant's takeaway paper bags (secondary packaging) is outside the scope of the food safety plan.

blocks.zh: 假設你的工廠同時生產注射用抗生素和口服維生素錠劑。根據 TR90 的範圍，這兩條產品線都需要建立 CCS 嗎？為什麼？
blocks.en: Suppose your site manufactures both an injectable antibiotic and oral vitamin tablets. Under the TR90 scope, do both product lines need a CCS? Why?

blocks.zh: 一位同事在 CCS 文件中加入了「防止 Product A 殘留污染 Product B」的章節。根據 TR90 的範圍定義，這樣做是否適當？為什麼？
blocks.en: A colleague adds a section to the CCS document on "preventing residues of Product A from contaminating Product B". Is this appropriate under the TR90 scope definition? Why?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR90 要把 inherent particulate matter（如蛋白質聚集體）排除在範圍之外？這對 CCS 的撰寫有什麼實務意義？
blocks.en: Why does TR90 exclude inherent particulate matter (such as protein aggregates) from its scope? What is the practical implication for writing a CCS?

blocks.zh: 2.0 Glossary and Abbreviations 2.0 術語彙編與縮寫
blocks.en: 2.0 Glossary and Abbreviations

blocks.zh: Alert Level vs. Action Limit 的差異至關重要：
blocks.en: The difference between Alert Level and Action Limit is critical:

blocks.zh: Alert Level (警戒水準)：像是汽車儀表板上的「油量偏低」警示燈。你注意到了，記錄下來，開始留意趨勢，但不需要立刻停車。
blocks.en: Alert Level: Like the "low fuel" warning light on a car dashboard. You notice it, record it and start watching the trend, but you do not need to stop the car immediately.

blocks.zh: Action Limit (行動限度)：像是「引擎溫度過高」警示燈。你必須立刻採取行動——停車、調查原因、修復問題，並且全部記錄在案。
blocks.en: Action Limit: Like the "engine overheating" warning light. You must act immediately: stop the car, investigate the cause, fix the problem, and document everything.

blocks.zh: 在環境監測 (EM) 中，超過 Alert Level 需要做趨勢分析；超過 Action Limit 則需要正式調查、產品影響評估和 CAPA。
blocks.en: In environmental monitoring (EM), exceeding an Alert Level calls for trend analysis; exceeding an Action Limit calls for a formal investigation, a product impact assessment and CAPA.

blocks.zh: Isolator vs. RABS 的差異：
blocks.en: The difference between Isolator and RABS:

blocks.zh: 把 Isolator (隔離器) 想像成太空站——它與外部環境完全隔離，所有物資進出都透過特殊的對接口（airlock），內部環境完全自主維持。
blocks.en: Think of an Isolator as a space station: it is completely separated from the external environment, all materials enter and leave through special docking ports (airlocks), and the internal environment is maintained entirely on its own.

blocks.zh: 把 RABS (限制進出屏障系統) 想像成潔淨室裡的手套箱——它有實體屏障和手套，但並非完全密封。就像你透過手套伸進箱子裡操作，但箱子上方仍與潔淨室空間相通。RABS 的門「很少打開」，但在嚴格定義的條件下可以打開。
blocks.en: Think of a RABS (Restricted Access Barrier System) as a glove box inside a cleanroom: it has a physical barrier and gloves, but it is not completely sealed. You reach into the box through the gloves, but the space above the box is still open to the cleanroom. RABS doors are "rarely opened", but can be opened under strictly defined conditions.

blocks.zh: 消毒等級概念層次 Decontamination Hierarchy
blocks.en: Decontamination Hierarchy

blocks.zh: 術語表中有好幾個「看起來很像」的概念，以下按照殺菌力從低到高排列：
blocks.en: The glossary contains several concepts that look alike. They are listed below from the lowest to the highest killing power:

blocks.zh: Sanitization 消毒處理
blocks.en: Sanitization

blocks.zh: Disinfection 消毒
blocks.en: Disinfection

blocks.zh: Sterilization 滅菌
blocks.en: Sterilization

blocks.zh: Sanitization：降低微生物數量（包含真菌、病毒、細菌）
blocks.en: Sanitization: Reduces the number of microorganisms (including fungi, viruses and bacteria)

blocks.zh: Disinfection：透過不可逆的作用破壞微生物結構/代謝，降低到「適當水準」
blocks.en: Disinfection: Destroys microbial structure/metabolism through an irreversible action, reducing the count to an "appropriate level"

blocks.zh: Sterilization：以特定機率 (如 SAL 10-6) 達到無活微生物的狀態——這是最高等級
blocks.en: Sterilization: Achieves a state free of viable microorganisms at a defined probability (such as SAL 10-6); this is the highest level

blocks.zh: Decontamination (去污染) 則是一個上位概念，涵蓋以上所有方法。
blocks.en: Decontamination is an overarching concept that covers all of the methods above.

blocks.zh: 縮寫速記 Abbreviation Quick Reference
blocks.en: Abbreviation Quick Reference

blocks.zh: 以下縮寫在整份 TR90 中反覆出現，請務必記住：
blocks.en: The following abbreviations appear repeatedly throughout TR90; be sure to remember them:

blocks.zh: CCS = Contamination Control Strategy (污染控制策略) — 本報告的核心
blocks.en: CCS = Contamination Control Strategy - the core of this report

blocks.zh: QRM = Quality Risk Management (品質風險管理) — CCS 的基礎工具
blocks.en: QRM = Quality Risk Management - the foundational tool of a CCS

blocks.zh: FMEA = Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (失效模式與效應分析) — 最常用的風險評估方法之一
blocks.en: FMEA = Failure Modes and Effects Analysis - one of the most commonly used risk assessment methods

blocks.zh: HACCP = Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (危害分析與重要管制點) — 來自食品業，也適用於製藥
blocks.en: HACCP = Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points - originating in the food industry and also applicable to pharmaceuticals

blocks.zh: HVAC = Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (空調系統) — 潔淨室的核心基礎設施
blocks.en: HVAC = Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning - the core infrastructure of a cleanroom

blocks.zh: 請解釋 Disinfection 和 Sterilization 的本質差異。為什麼在無菌製程中我們不能只靠 disinfection？
blocks.en: Explain the essential difference between disinfection and sterilization. Why can we not rely on disinfection alone in aseptic processing?

blocks.zh: Closed Isolator 和 Open Isolator 的主要差異是什麼？在什麼樣的製程中你會選擇使用 Open Isolator？
blocks.en: What is the main difference between a Closed Isolator and an Open Isolator? For what kind of process would you choose an Open Isolator?

blocks.zh: 某次環境監測結果超過了 Alert Level 但未超過 Action Limit。你應該採取什麼行動？和超過 Action Limit 時的處理方式有何不同？
blocks.en: An environmental monitoring result exceeds the Alert Level but not the Action Limit. What action should you take? How does it differ from the handling when an Action Limit is exceeded?

blocks.zh: FMEA 和 HACCP 都是風險評估工具。請簡述它們各自的特點，以及在 CCS 中可能的應用場景。
blocks.en: FMEA and HACCP are both risk assessment tools. Briefly describe the characteristics of each and where each might be applied in a CCS.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 場景：假設你是一家 CDMO 的品質部門主管，公司即將接受歐洲客戶的稽核，而該客戶要求你們提供符合 EU GMP Annex 1 的 CCS 文件。
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: Suppose you are the head of quality at a CDMO. The company is about to be audited by a European client, and that client requires you to provide a CCS document that complies with EU GMP Annex 1.

blocks.zh: 你的第一步不是「從零開始撰寫 CCS」，而是：
blocks.en: Your first step is not to "write the CCS from scratch", but to:

blocks.zh: 盤點現有的污染控制措施（環境監測計畫、清潔驗證、人員更衣程序、HVAC 確效等）
blocks.en: Take inventory of the existing contamination control measures (environmental monitoring program, cleaning validation, personnel gowning procedures, HVAC qualification, and so on)

blocks.zh: 用 TR90 的框架（Section 3.0 的 CCS 元素）作為檢查清單
blocks.en: Use the TR90 framework (the CCS elements in Section 3.0) as a checklist

blocks.zh: 將分散的文件整合到一份 CCS 總覽文件 (umbrella document) 中
blocks.en: Consolidate the scattered documents into one CCS overview (umbrella document)

blocks.zh: 識別缺口 (gaps) 並制定改善計畫
blocks.en: Identify gaps and develop an improvement plan

blocks.zh: 這份術語表 (Glossary) 就是你確保團隊「說同一種語言」的起點。
blocks.en: This glossary is the starting point for making sure your team "speaks the same language".

blocks.zh: 核心術語對照 Key Term Translations
blocks.en: Key Terms

blocks.zh: 以下是本節術語的繁體中文對照與重點解說，建議熟記：
blocks.en: Below are the key terms of this section with brief explanations; it is worth committing them to memory:

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: CCS 是一份「傘式文件」：它不新增控制措施，而是將現有的污染控制實踐整合、串連，並評估其整體有效性。
blocks.en: A CCS is an "umbrella document": It does not add new controls; it integrates and links existing contamination control practices and evaluates their overall effectiveness.

blocks.zh: 從零散到整體 (Holistic Approach)：TR90 推動的核心轉變是從「各自為政的 GMP 實踐」走向「互相配合、針對特定風險量身定制的整體策略」。
blocks.en: From fragmented to holistic: The core shift TR90 promotes is from "GMP practices that each operate on their own" to "an integrated strategy whose parts work together and are tailored to specific risks".

blocks.zh: 範圍聚焦：TR90 專注於微生物污染、熱原/內毒素、外來微粒三大類型，涵蓋無菌藥品、低生物負荷原料藥及易受污染的非無菌藥品。化學污染和固有微粒不在範圍內。
blocks.en: Focused scope: TR90 concentrates on three types of contamination (microbial contamination, pyrogens/endotoxin and foreign particulate matter) and covers sterile drugs, low bioburden drug substances and nonsterile drugs vulnerable to contamination. Chemical contamination and inherent particulate matter are out of scope.

blocks.zh: TR90 是路線圖 (Roadmap)：它不取代各項專業技術指引，而是提供一個框架，幫助你把所有相關文件和實踐組織成一個有邏輯的整體。
blocks.en: TR90 is a roadmap: It does not replace the individual specialist technical guidance; it provides a framework that helps you organize all the relevant documents and practices into one logical whole.

blocks.zh: 術語是溝通基礎：熟悉 Glossary 中的定義（尤其是 Alert Level vs. Action Limit、Isolator vs. RABS、消毒/滅菌層次等），是有效建立和評估 CCS 的前提。
blocks.en: Terminology is the basis of communication: Being familiar with the Glossary definitions (especially Alert Level vs. Action Limit, Isolator vs. RABS, and the disinfection/sterilization hierarchy) is a prerequisite for building and evaluating a CCS effectively.
